source.author: lucan
source.text: Cornus tibi cura sinistri, Lentule, cum prima, quae tum fuit optima bello, Et quarta legione datur: tibi, numine pugnax Adverso Domiti, dextri frons tradita Martis.
source.text_original: Cornus tibi cura sinistri, / Lentule, cum prima, quae tum fuit optima bello, / Et quarta legione datur: tibi, numine pugnax / Adverso Domiti, dextri frons tradita Martis.
source.text_english: Lentulus, the care of the left flank is given to you with the first legion, which then was the best in war, and the fourth; to you is entrusted the front of the right-hand side of Mars, fighting under the hostile divinity of Domitius.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Arge, tuae tibi cura ratis, te moenia doctum Thespia Palladio dant munere; sors tibi, nequa parte trahat tacitum puppis mare fissaque fluctu vel pice vel molli conducere vulnera cera.
reuse.text_original: Arge, tuae tibi cura ratis, te moenia doctum / Thespia Palladio dant munere; sors tibi, nequa / parte trahat tacitum puppis mare fissaque fluctu / vel pice vel molli conducere vulnera cera.
reuse.text_english: Argos, the care of your own ship is yours; the walls of Thespia, skilled in Pallas’ gift, are given to you. Your task is to see that in no way the silent sea drag your ship, and to seal up the wounds split open by the wave, whether with pitch or with soft wax.
